name: investment.strategies

get.description: Read one native investment strategy rule by its strategyRuleCode.

lookup.name: strategyRuleCode
lookup.description: Native strategy rule code from a verified product record or code selector; not a strategy template ID.

result_identity.description: Native strategyRuleCode must exactly echo the requested code.

purpose: Read the complete strategy rule root and its native nested settings.
identity_description: Get-only; native strategyRuleCode identifies the returned root.
limitations: Live-only native root detail; no List, cached result or Duckdog dataset.
Separate histories and strategy execution results are unqueried.
A strategy rule code is distinct from strategyRuleId and mainStrategyTemplateId.

examples.title: Read a verified native rule code
